patch.value: Honor caller changelog policy in gated sync and closeout
Use the caller's changelog scripts for gated sync and closeout, and validate regenerated output before publication.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Both reusable workflows regenerate after the tracker writes, but inject a pending-release override for changelog:full. Run the declared caller script and its optional changelog:check before the existing privacy scan, then keep the regenerated changelog in the tracker commit. Preserve the no-tracker-change publication path.

value.text: Confirmed tracker_changed in the audit-windows log for pm-brief#224 and the test (22) log for pm-context#222. The baseline closeout discard branch runs only when the workflow has no closeout proposal. Preserve that behavior and keep both changelogs with the corresponding tracker edits.
